decision_basis: The frozen offline conjunction failed synthetic and natural attribution; conditional live branches were therefore cancelled.
interpretation: The attribution instruction made the 8B teacher consistently over-abstain; it reduced weak-gold false updates but lost too many true Skill updates.
The existing deterministic rule-first assigner prevented regressions, but the Meta-Skill added no update-yield improvement on either natural fault.
Patch success was already saturated by the current evidence-corrected compiled-rule path, so 20/20 does not demonstrate incremental Meta-Skill value.
High metamorphic agreement shows stable behavior, not useful behavior.
The frozen bundle increased matched core teacher/patch tokens by 43.1 percent while failing the benefit gates.
limitations: Natural labels are injected-fault weak gold; control events are not independently annotated for unrelated defects.
The observe-and-recover executor Skill was not evaluated because the frozen offline gate failed, so Phase3C makes no claim about its execution-only utility.
Static stage contracts prevent evaluation-label leakage, but prompt-section placement cannot provide attention-level isolation inside one executor model.
